intro: Mia is cast out as a jinx, the little girl everyone blames when something goes wrong. Then the elite Murphy family takes her in and sees something nobody else did: a child whose presence seems to turn their luck around. It reads like a heartwarming fantasy novel, now on screen: a tiny heroine, a family that chooses her, and a lot of people about to regret how they treated her.
why: A little heroine the world rejected, and a family that decides she is a blessing.
Gentle fantasy luck that changes the fortunes of everyone around her.
Plenty of satisfying moments when those who called her a jinx see the truth.
Good pick if you like wholesome family stories with a touch of magic.
